status: Initial artist interface using coder proposal; geometry follows in the next checkpoint.
coordinateSystem: Local metres; X/Z ground, Y up; original house origin retained.

data.surfaces: Array {id,kind,level,triangles,normal,thickness,material,bounds,sourceMeshBindings,supportSurfaceIds,fuelClass,fuelAmount,finish}; one canonical record per physical patch
data.openings: Array {id,surfaceId,level,kind,bounds,polygon,pivot,closedTransform,openTransform,sourceMeshBindings}; source geometry and prototype adaptations distinguished
data.items: Array grouping actual furnitureParts by itemId; independent item transforms and support bindings
data.stores: Array {id,itemId,kind,level,position,bounds,amount,amountUnit,supportSurfaceIds,fuelPartId}; fuel appears once in furnitureParts
data.render: Canonical source geometries, physical material appearances and per-fragment source/item bindings; no new donor import
data.navigation: Measured baseline bounds and explicit authorized adaptations; freeze after coder passage measurement

frame.boundaries: Array {id,sourceSurfaceId,triangles or polygon,intact,openFraction,charFraction,heatFraction}; additional patch coverage retires only its actual geometry
frame.supports: Same stable sourceSurfaceId/coverage convention as boundaries
frame.items: Array {id or itemId,position,quaternion,intact,remainingFraction,charFraction}; matrix accepted as an alternative pose
frame.falls: Array {id,itemId,position,quaternion,flame,smoke,ignitionTime}; moved fuel remains the same item
frame.events: Array of authoritative window-break, spill, support-failure and landing records
frame.metrics: Authoritative accounting and budgets; presentation never derives gameplay
frame.fireSamples: Published structural-fire fields plus sourceSurfaceId or itemId; floorFootprint triangles or floorRadius bounds the visible horizontal envelope
frame.tombstones: Array of stable ids, or {collection,id}; records removed from retained state. An intact:false record is also accepted.
frame.occupancy: Optional debug records {id,bounds,heatFraction,occupied}; x-ray shows these actual simulation records when supplied

view.sampleWind: optional function supplied by the host; no frozen Ashland wind field applied to Hopkins

rules: Cutaway never changes physical openings or surviving support.
An opening openFraction changes glass/door presentation; intact:false retires the physical record and its shadow.
Physical patch coverage is required for a runtime patch smaller than an artist surface.
Full frames replace state; later frames merge stable-ID changes and tombstones. Reset/backward seek clears prior state.
Fuel amounts are finite prototype units, not a calibrated real-world mass model. Coder owns burn profiles.
Original 1.65 m doors remain identified until the measured passage decision. No actor is resized.
